title: Search endpoint after load testing
transcript:
[00:00] Mirela: The new search endpoint is merged. Relevance looks much better in the side-by-side.
[00:06] Kofi: Latency is fine on my machine, but that's a hundred documents, not two million.
[00:12] Jun: The index on production is a lot bigger, yes.
[00:16] Mirela: So, plan: once it's load tested, we switch traffic over.
[00:21] Kofi: OK. I'll do the load test this week.
[00:25] Jun: I'll keep the old endpoint running for two weeks after the switch, in case we need to roll back.
[00:33] Mirela: Good. And the switch happens behind the search flag, not a deploy.
[00:39] Kofi: Yes, flag only.
[00:43] Jun: Should we tell the mobile team? Their app calls search directly.
[00:48] Mirela: I'll message them today.
[00:52] Kofi: Thanks.
[00:56] Mirela: That's all. Thanks.
